title: .respawnpack/runtime/feedback-export-<date>.json — a project's pack-directed feedback, packaged without its operational detail
description: Written by kernel/respawnpack.js `feedback --export` and read back by the same file's `memory candidates import <file>` in a dev checkout. G16, decision 50. It carries only PACK-DIRECTED records (candidates, graph entities and decisions that name a pack identifier), each reduced to this allow-listed shape, after a mechanical redaction fence and an owner preview. ⛔ IT CARRIES NO OPERATIONAL DETAIL: every free-text field passed the redaction fence (no non-pack path, IP, hostname, email, URL, high-entropy token, or secret shape), and the fence catches SHAPES, not meaning, which is why the preview is the owner's last sight of what leaves. The `provenance.projectId` is sixteen random bytes minted machine-locally, so a receiver correlates exports from one install without learning anything about the project; `packVersion` is the receipt's self-report, which a hand edit can forge, so the receiver verifies it against its own known releases and reads CANNOT_DETERMINE when it cannot. The wire format is frozen at schemaVersion 1.0.0, pinned by kernel/schema.test.mjs; additionalProperties is false everywhere so a hand-added field is a rejection, not a stowaway.

schemaVersion.description: The wire format version, frozen. The receiver refuses a package whose version it does not implement rather than guessing at an unknown shape.

kind.description: Distinguishes this package from every other JSON a reader might be handed.

provenance.description: Who the export is from, verified by the receiver against its own known releases. Nothing here identifies the project beyond the machine-local random projectId.

packVersion.description: The release the exporting install recorded in its receipt (install:pack-version), or null when the receipt predates the field — in which case the receiver reads the whole import as CANNOT_DETERMINE. Self-reported and forgeable, so the receiver matches it to its own VERSION or a CHANGELOG ## [x.y.z] heading and never trusts it blind.

receiptSchemaVersion.description: The install receipt's schemaVersion at export time, or null when there was no receipt.

projectType.description: The exporting project's declared projectType, or null when it declared none.

posture.description: The resolved posture profile of the exporting project, or null when none resolved.

projectId.description: Sixteen random bytes as hex, minted once at the first export into .respawnpack/feedback-id (gitignored, machine-local). Every export from one install carries the same id; a clone mints its own. Null only in a preview before any --out export has minted one.

exportedAt.description: ISO timestamp the export was written. The receiver requires it to parse.

counts.description: The reduction, in numbers nothing hides behind: every record is named in the preview, so these are a summary, not a substitute.

included.description: Pack-directed records that passed the fence and are in this package.

excluded.description: considered minus included: not-pack-directed, dropped by the owner, or fence-blocked.

fieldsDropped.description: Non-mechanical evidence paths dropped from the included records during reduction.

records.description: The included records, each reduced to the allow-listed fields and nothing else.

kind.description: Which classified source this came from.

sourceId.description: The record's id in the exporting store (a candidate id, an entity id, a decision id), carried so the owner can name a record to --drop.

klass.description: A candidate's klass; null for an entity or decision.

verificationState.description: A candidate's verificationState (candidate | verified | rejected); null for an entity or decision.

identifiers.description: The manifest identifiers this record named — why it is pack-directed.

claim.description: The first sentence of a candidate's or decision's claim; null for an entity. Passed the redaction fence.

rejectionReason.description: The first sentence of a rejected candidate's rejection reason; null otherwise. Passed the redaction fence.

observation.description: The first sentence of an entity's first observation; null for a candidate or decision. Passed the redaction fence.

retracted.description: True when an entity is under memory/graph/_retracted/; null for a candidate or decision.

evidence.description: ONLY mechanical tokens: a pack file:line, a verb, a hook or doctor-row id, an exit code, a posture or config key. Everything else was dropped and counted in counts.fieldsDropped.

capturedBy.description: The machine author CLASS only (savepoint | operator | closeout | adapter | import | other), never a person's name.

at.description: The date the record was captured or promoted (YYYY-MM-DD), or null.
